steps.en: OCMS receives the court application outcome file from State Courts
steps.id: OCMS menerima file hasil permohonan court dari State Courts
steps.why_en: No connection to the State Courts file exchange exists, so no return file can arrive.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada sambungan ke pertukaran file State Courts, jadi file hasil tidak bisa masuk.

steps.en: File can arrive as one batch or smaller sub-batches
steps.id: File bisa datang sebagai satu batch atau sub-batch
steps.why_en: The system has no notion of a court application batch, so batches and sub-batches cannot be handled.
steps.why_id: Sistem tidak punya konsep batch permohonan court, jadi batch dan sub-batch tidak bisa ditangani.

steps.en: Notices in the batch are updated from the file
steps.id: Notice di batch diperbarui dari isi file
steps.why_en: Only a one-notice-at-a-time update from another system exists, not processing of a returned file.
steps.why_id: Yang ada hanya update satu notice per kiriman dari sistem lain, bukan pemrosesan file kembalian.

steps.en: Batch and notice status are marked as processed
steps.id: Status batch dan notice ditandai sudah diproses
steps.why_en: There is no batch status to update and the screen that would show it is switched off.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada status batch yang bisa diupdate dan layar yang menampilkannya dimatikan.
